exact_duplicate_policy: Retain the first full-record occurrence in source order; remove later full-record-equal occurrences only from the derived model input.
unknown_exercise_policy: Exclude from Q-matrix-based model input and report separately.
unmapped_topic_policy: Exclude an observed exercise if its metadata has no single non-missing Topic mapping; do not infer a replacement concept.
raw_prerequisite_policy: Measure only as raw evidence in the candidate-specific induced graph; do not publish or use it as a production graph.
